description: Source code for the PersistentStore class implementation, managing initialization, deinitialization, and configuration of persistent storage within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Implementation class for managing persistent storage within the plugin, including initialization, cleanup, and configuration handling.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the persistent store, sets environment variables, manages legacy files, and registers storage interfaces.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters interfaces, releases references, and terminates connections.

methods.name: PersistentStore::Information
methods.description: Returns a string with information about the persistent store (currently empty).
